requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and encryption of user data to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and low-energy communication protocols to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting and allow data anonymization.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support compliance and analysis.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications and integrate data anonymization.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement a unified role-based access control system that ensures security and performance efficiency.
The system shall evaluate the energy impact of real-time updates to ensure alignment with low-energy protocols.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
